art_direction: 浅藕粉底，间距略近，双眼认真睁开，像在确认眼前的新发现。
composition_variation: Bring the eyes moderately close, right a little higher and left wider. Open both to sixty percent beneath thick bowed lids and large forward black pupils. Round the lower edges with matching iris bands along the lower sides. Create quiet attentive surprise, with focused gaze rather than blank staring. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
